long_biography.plain_text:
Praxis Global Investments holds Athina Kyriakou's interest in K Group. She established the Luxembourg company as its sole shareholder in 2014 and planned a merger with an Irish company she also owned. The structure gave her a separate holding vehicle for her share of the family businesses.

Her work in television preceded the Luxembourg company. After studying in the United States, Kyriakou joined Antenna, where her responsibilities included programme acquisition: selecting and buying content for broadcast. By 2008, she was part of the broadcaster's acquisition team, working closely with John Latsios and George Levendis.
